summary:
Detailed summary of navigation and performance optimizations:
1. Resolved navigation trapping: Users can now return to the Home Screen from anywhere (TopBar Home tab, brand logo, MobileBottomNav Home tab, FocusedProviderProfile header 'Home Screen' button, breadcrumb link, and floating return pill).
2. Resolved app freezing and UI lockups: Debounced text inputs in NationalGeographicExplorer and PredictiveLeadQueue, eliminated unneeded computation of 20,973 cities during states mode, early-exit search cap at 300 records, and consolidated 17 sequential loops into a single O(N) accumulator pass in GisTerritoryHeatmap.
3. Verified clean compilation and zero linter warnings.
